question:
Choose the one which can be substituted for the given sentence.'

A short stay at a place
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sojourn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Sojourn"** means a temporary stay at a place. (अस्थायी निवास)

 
 
• **Example:** During his sojourn in Paris, he learned French and explored the city’s culture.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for a "short stay at a place" is **"Sojourn"**. (अस्थायी निवास)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sojourn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Odyssey** (लंबी यात्रा): A long, adventurous journey.

 
 
• **Example:** The explorers embarked on an odyssey to discover new lands.
 
 
 
• **Peregrination** (भ्रमण): A long journey, especially one undertaken on foot.
 
 
• **Example:** His peregrination across Europe was both tiring and fulfilling.
 
 
 
• **Exodus** (प्रस्थान): A mass departure of people.
 
 
• **Example:** The exodus of workers from the city after the factory shut down was unprecedented.
